nodes.label: Native PROCESS_TEXT Interception Architecture
nodes.rationale: Selected over Userscript (no mixed-content or CORS constraints, universal across all Android browsers) and direct 115 cloud API calls (avoids duplicating OAuth token refresh and CID folder resolution on client).

nodes.label: Root-to-App Sandbox Token Bridge
nodes.rationale: Companion APK runs under an unprivileged Android UID unable to access 0700 root directories; Root service.sh securely extracts Token from data.db and mirrors offline.conf into app private files.
